log_sensitivity: SHEET: single traced envelope 390-545nm (the chart draws the emulsions fused at this resolution)
ASSUMED: three-channel split — blue = envelope, green = envelope shifted +70nm, red = blind
SHEET: no ink beyond ~545nm — the >=555nm blindness is directly evidenced (safelight region)

REANCHORED (M9-2 T2): the blind third channel lifted -10 -> -6 (1e-6 transmission — the physical safelight-blocking magnitude, not an absolute zero): the build's geometric-mean exposure normalization over the three print channels collapsed at 1e-10, inflating midgrayFactor ~1e4 and pushing the print table's log exposure (4.0-5.0) past the paper curves' domain ceiling — the print_develop stage clamped every pixel to the curve tail and the chain output a constant
density_curves: ASSUMED: grade labels unreadable at chart resolution; T2 fits m/y per grade

bw_grade_curves.note: the three traced grade members (soft/mid/hard by measured span); the main density_curves rows carry them per channel — T2's PaperGradeTable fits each grade's m/y/exposure against the datasheet ISO R table
